fact: The Central Information Systems Division's Application Development Unit says it designs, develops, deploys and maintains applications for various ministries and government departments on the GOC Cloud.
The Application Development Unit of the ministry's CISD says it fixes bugs and upgrades the applications it develops for ministries.

The Central Information Systems Division says its on-site officers work with ministry officers as database, system and network administrators running ministries' computerised systems, and that application systems are now managed in-house by the respective institutions.

The Central Information Systems Division, a division of the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, says it has developed over 120 application systems and provides payroll, email, websites, network and backup services to Ministries and Departments.
CISD says it maintains 32 application systems and runs email administration, network administration and database administration for the Civil Service.
CISD, a division of the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, says it develops and runs application systems and services for Ministries and Departments.
CISD says its new Government payroll system was developed entirely in-house and went live in July 2024.
CISD says the new Government payroll system was developed entirely in-house, with no supplier named.
CISD says its Application Development Unit fully rolled out the Bad Weather Allowance System for the Ministry of Agro-Industry, with no contractor named.
CISD lists the Flight Clearance system among its 2024 releases, phases 1 to 3 live, with no contractor named.
